handoff.purpose: Finalize task selection and define correctness_gate closure for task verification.

symbols.name: correctness_gate
symbols.note: Returns a callable gate for TaskAttempt. Validates task, checks before-state, verifies selection digest, and runs tests via runner.

claims.text: IT FAILS CLOSED ON AN UNVERIFIED TASK, and that is the point.
claims.why: In _gate, if receipt.get('verified') is not truthy, it returns verdict(False, ...).

claims.text: A task with no verified before-state receipt for ctx.base_revision is REFUSED (passed=False) rather than evaluated
claims.why: The code checks receipt.get('verified') and returns verdict(False) if not verified.

claims.text: IT ALSO REFUSES A SELECTION THAT MOVED. The receipt records the digest of the selection it was measured under; this recomputes that digest from the task as presented and refuses on any mismatch.
claims.why: Code recomputes selection = freeze_selection(task, recorded, timeout_s) and compares selection.digest with declared; returns verdict(False) on mismatch.

claims.text: Widening the lists after the verification (say, to include a test the candidate itself added), narrowing them to drop an inconvenient one, or pointing them at a different base all change the digest and all get the same refusal.
claims.why: The digest is computed from the task (including fail_to_pass, pass_to_pass, etc.) and the base revision; any change alters digest, causing mismatch refusal.

claims.text: What this gate adds over spine.attempt.pytest_gate: pytest_gate asks 'did the suite exit 0', which a candidate satisfies by changing nothing. This asks 'did the previously-RED tests go GREEN, and did the previously-GREEN ones stay green' -- a question a no-op change cannot pass.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain the implementation of spine.attempt.pytest_gate, nor does it run any tests to verify the claim about 'previously-RED tests go GREEN'. The gate only validates task and selection; actual test running is delegated to runner (not shown).

claims.text: Signature and return type match the attempt's gate contract exactly ((RunnerContext) -> GateResult), so wiring is TaskAttempt(..., gate=correctness_gate(task, repo_root)) with no change to spine/ at all.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain the definition of TaskAttempt or its gate contract; the claim about matching signature cannot be verified from this code alone.

observations.what: Function correctness_gate returns a closure _gate that uses runner (defaulting to run_node_ids) and root.
freeze_selection and judge_before_state are called but defined outside this chunk.
apply_test_overlay is called at the end but not defined in this chunk.
validate_task is called but not defined in this chunk; its behavior is assumed.
